outline.user:
Create a DETAILED, LONG, SEO-optimized outline for a {total_words}-word recipe article based ONLY on the provided Recipe text and the Recipe Card.
- Language: {article_language}.
- STRICT DATA FIDELITY: Use ONLY information present in the Recipe for ingredients and steps.
- STRICT CARD FIDELITY: For timings/servings/course/cuisine/calories use the Recipe Card EXACTLY. If any card field is N/A, treat it as 'Not specified in the recipe'.
- Use H2/H3 only (no H1).
- IMPORTANT: Do NOT prefix ANY headings with numbers, numerals, or roman numerals.
- The outline MUST start EXACTLY with these H2 labels (no numbering):
  ## Introduction
  ## Recipe Overview
  ## {ingredients_label}
- Then include AT LEAST 10 additional H2 sections; each H2 should have 2–4 H3 subsections.
- END with a neutral Conclusion summarizing taste/texture/timing in 2–4 sentences. NO CTAs.

part1.user:
Write PART 1 of a LONG, detailed SEO-optimized recipe article based ONLY on the provided Recipe text and Recipe Card.
- Language: {article_language}.
- TARGET LENGTH for Part 1: 900–1000 words (do not be brief).
- STRICT: Use ONLY ingredients and steps present in the Recipe; no new ingredients, brands, or quantities not present.
- STRICT CARD FIDELITY (MUST): For Prep/Cook/Total/Course/Cuisine/Servings/Calories, use the Recipe Card EXACTLY. If any card value is N/A, write 'Not specified in the recipe'. DO NOT estimate or invent.
- The **very first line MUST be a single H1 in the exact form: '# {{Title}}'** with nothing before it.
- H1 Title rules (VERY IMPORTANT):
  • Be CLEAR and SPECIFIC about the recipe.
  • Length: 6–12 words AND roughly 45–70 characters.
  • Include the core recipe name as written in the Recipe.
  • Allowed simple adjectives if true: Easy, Simple, Homemade, Quick.
  • NO emojis, NO quotes, NO brackets, NO pipes/double dashes. Avoid dates/years/clickbait.
  • Use natural Title Case or Sentence case.
- Then follow this EXACT order using NON-NUMBERED headings:
  ## Introduction — 2–4 short paragraphs that set context, taste, and when to serve.
  ## Recipe Overview — MUST use EXACTLY the following bullets (copy them as-is, same order, same labels):
{overview_lines}  IMPORTANT: Do NOT add or change any values in the bullets above.
  ## {ingredients_label}
     - Bullet list of ALL ingredients extracted from the Recipe ONLY.
  ## Instructions — numbered, step-by-step, derived strictly from the Recipe.
- After these, cover the remaining H2/H3 from the outline part with rich paragraphs.
- Do NOT write a conclusion in Part 1. NO calls to action.
